title: Good: Epoch wraparound correctly rejected with SECURITY comment
description:
Location: rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs lines 251-260

The ReplayProtector correctly handles epoch wraparound:
- epoch > last_epoch: accept, reset window
- epoch == last_epoch: check seqnum window
- epoch < last_epoch: reject (replay)

When epoch wraps from 255 to 0, the comparison 0 < 255 correctly triggers rejection. This prevents an attacker from re-using old (epoch, seqnum) pairs after rollover.

The SECURITY comment on lines 251-252 documents the rationale: 'Epochs are finite for a given public key. Wrapping from 255 to 0 is a rollback and must be rejected - require key rotation.'

Test coverage: epoch_wraparound_rejected_for_same_pubkey (line 797) verifies this behavior.
